title: Decision
description: One answer of the decision backend to one suspect event, published on plant/{unit_id}/decisions. A failed call is still a decision: status failed, choice none_of_these, confidence 0 and a non-null error. The state the backend saw never travels here; only its sha256 does.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.description: One catalog cause retrieval offered to the backend, with the probability the backend gave it.

name.description: The cause name from the catalog.

benign.description: True when the cause is normal operation rather than a defect.

model.description: Model identifier the answer came from; rules-v1 for the rules backend.

status.description: Whether the backend answered at all.

probabilities.description: Mass over the candidate fault ids plus none_of_these; sums to 1.

support.description: Per-candidate support, one entry per candidate fault id. Backends without a per-candidate question send an empty object.

candidates.description: The causes retrieval offered, at most six; empty on a failed call.

severity.description: How serious the situation is, from the severity Score. score is the level index and probabilities are keyed by that index.

score.description: Index of the chosen severity level, 0 low to 3 critical.

gate.description: What the confidence gate decided, with the thresholds it used.

outcome.description: ticket opens or updates a ticket, review opens one with status review, log records the decision only.

abstained.description: True when the backend said none_of_these with a confidence at or above the review threshold.

reason.description: One sentence naming the rule that produced the outcome.

ticket_min_confidence.description: The ticket threshold the gate applied to this decision's backend: VON_GATE_TICKET_MIN_CONFIDENCE for von, GATE_TICKET_MIN_CONFIDENCE for rules and llm.

review_min_confidence.description: The review threshold the gate applied to this decision's backend: VON_GATE_REVIEW_MIN_CONFIDENCE for von, GATE_REVIEW_MIN_CONFIDENCE for rules and llm.

persist_sim_min.description: GATE_PERSIST_SIM_MIN: sim minutes a symptom's evidence must have held without a break before an episode that owns no ticket is decided, so before it can open a review or a ticket. 0 decides at once. Optional: messages written before the parameter existed do not carry it.

usage.description: Tokens the backend reported; zeros for the rules backend and for a failed call.

cost.description: usd = (input_tokens x price_input_per_mtok + output_tokens x price_output_per_mtok) / 1e6, at the prices of prices_as_of.

prices_as_of.description: The day the prices were read, as YYYY-MM-DD.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the backend call.

request_id.description: Provider request id, when the provider returned one.

rationale.description: The LLM backend's own short justification; no other backend sets it.

state_digest.description: sha256 of the JSON state the backend saw. The state itself goes to the database, never to the broker.

error.description: Null on an answered call; otherwise why the call failed.

status.description: HTTP status, when the failure carried one.
